title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00105 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 07:00: Worked on preparing WL cutting equipment built up WL tool string on pipe deck, prepared winch. Meanwhile picked up 10 3/4 cutter assy and broke off cutter, redressed knives on cutter for 9 5/8 casing. L/d same
07:00 - 07:30: TBT before installing sheeves and picking up wireline string
07:30 - 08:45: M/u tool string
08:45 - 09:15: Checked WL cutter tool string and positioned top sheave over drill string
09:15 - 11:00: RIH w/ WL cutter from surface to cutting depth of 2346m. Correlated by CCL log
11:00 - 11:30: Applied 10 ton overpull to drill string, 153t on martin decker. Set WL anchor. Cut CSG. Took 7 min to make cut
11:30 - 12:00: Observed back flow from drill string
12:00 - 12:15: Released WL anchor. Set tool for POOH
12:15 - 13:45: POOH w/ WL cutter from 2346 m to surface
13:45 - 14:00: L/d WL tool string
14:00 - 15:45: Circulated bu 900 LPM, 7. 5 bar, 1. 1sg fluid in returns. Meanwhile r/d WL equipment. Changed master bushing to PS 21
15:45 - 16:00: Flow checked well. Static
16:00 - 16:15: POOH w/ drill pipe from 2346m to 2320m l/d out 2 x singles
16:15 - 18:45: POOH w/ drill pipe from 2320m to 868m
18:45 - 23:00: Repaired leak on aft PRS. Changed out burst hose on main arm
23:00 - 00:00: POOH 5 ½ DP to surface
